description: This file defines the SearchScreen UI component for an Android app, including various composable functions for search bar, results, recent searches, and handling different states in the search process.

methods.name: SearchScreen
methods.description: Main composable function that displays the search interface, including search bar, results, recent searches, and handling different UI states.

methods.name: EmptySearchResultBody
methods.description: Displays a message when no search results are found, with a link to browse topics.

methods.name: SearchNotReadyBody
methods.description: Displays a message when the search feature is not ready.

methods.name: SearchResultBody
methods.description: Displays the search results including topics and news resources, with a staggered grid layout.

methods.name: RecentSearchesBody
methods.description: Shows the list of recent search queries with an option to clear.

methods.name: SearchToolbar
methods.description: Top app bar with back button and search text field.

methods.name: SearchTextField
methods.description: Text input field for entering search queries, with icons for clear and search actions.

calls: Navigation and UI update methods like onBackClick, onSearchQueryChanged, onSearchTriggered, etc.
